notes: At this revision 10 of 67,896 labels do not lie inside their file (6 with an empty value, 4 past the line or file end; all F or X, no T); they are dropped and counted in the report.

Labels are lines from 337 open-source repositories that several secret scanners flagged, reviewed by people: T credential, F not a credential, X undecided. A finding on an unlabelled line counts as a false positive, though no tool flagged that line and it may hold an unlabelled credential.
A label with value offsets is scored on the value; without them (most F, a few T), on its whole line(s). Precision any-label counts spans on F lines as hits: use typed precision.
True credentials were replaced by seeded random look-alikes of the same shape (CredData's obfuscation), so prefix and length rules see realistic values; checksums are not kept.
Files are scored in a fixed order of the SHA-256 of their path, so `--limit N` is a spread sample across repositories, the same for every system.
Slice path_kind: test_or_example when the dataset's path scope names test, mock, fixture, example or sample; other otherwise.
